title: The school takeover deadlines, in order
subtitle: State law sets each date; the middle two are the parent-petition path
alt: Timeline of the deadlines in the state takeover question facing the Austin school district: Webb and Burnet middle schools received a fifth straight preliminary failing rating in August 2026, the district must appeal those preliminary ratings by September 11, parents must present a closure petition to the superintendent for validation by October 15, and the superintendent must forward a validated petition to the education commissioner by December 1

events.label: Webb and Burnet get a fifth straight failing rating
events.note: Preliminary 2025-26 ratings from the Texas Education Agency

events.label: The district's deadline to appeal the ratings
events.note: If a rating becomes final, the commissioner must intervene

events.label: Parents' deadline to file a closure petition
events.note: It needs parents of a majority of a campus's students

events.label: Superintendent's deadline to forward a validated petition
events.note: A valid petition generally obliges the commissioner to act on it

next.label: Without a petition, Commissioner Mike Morath chooses: close the campuses or replace the elected board
